  \caption{\textbf{GSPA integrator over AllTheBacteria genomes.} Stage D (all batches) covers every genome of every completed wave-1 and wave-2 batch, each wave-1 species representative counted once; run (a) covers the genomes that Stage C had already integrated, the first $20$ by sample identifier in each batch. Both runs use \texttt{gspa-unified.jar} v2.1.0 with all six priors, three iterations, and Stage 2A relaxation, compared with Stage 0 noisy-OR on the same claims. A protein is rescued when it gains its first GO term with posterior $\ge 0.50$; a pair is suppressed when its posterior falls below $0.50$ or Stage 2A removes it. Rescues by prior count a protein under every prior with a positive entry for a rescued pair. Co-annotation conflicts include pairs that Stage 2A removed without a forbidden-table hit. Taxon-forbidden suppression requires the genome's taxid in the integrator's bundled NCBI hierarchy ($1{,}302$ taxa). The gap claims are KEGG-coverage gaps written by the batch pipeline. Runtime is the per-genome wall time reported by the JVM: single-threaded runs in Stage C for run (a), and the per-genome time inside the $96$-genome multi-threaded batch runs for Stage D. Sources: \texttt{results/allthebacteria/atb\_java\_summary\_stageD.json}, \texttt{atb\_java\_summary.json}, \texttt{insight3\_per\_genome\_java\_stageD.tsv.gz}, \texttt{insight3\_per\_genome\_java.tsv} (pipeline P11, \texttt{benchmark/allthebacteria/aggregate\_atb\_java.py}).}
